recommendation: Keep this fix. If the FHIR model-info Library artifacts are regenerated, ensure ResearchSubject.status remains FHIR.PublicationStatus and that FHIR.ResearchSubjectStatus is not reintroduced for this status element.
issue_request: FHIR-31689 was a Published/Persuasive BRR R5 change request asking that ResearchSubject.status be restricted to publication status rather than the large subject progress/state value set.
initial_application: Commit 85a2ee09a39be6c5ae5b6a97eec3d21f46970051 applied the main ResearchSubject change by binding ResearchSubject.status to PublicationStatus and updating status-codes.xml to publication codes. It did not update the active FHIR model-info Library artifacts, which still exposed ResearchSubject.status as FHIR.ResearchSubjectStatus and retained matching conversion/helper entries.
additional_context: FHIR-31657 approved the ResearchSubject progress attribute and explicitly noted that status should refer just to publication status. FHIR-31690 belongs to the same ResearchSubject progress/status family but concerns progress endDate and already has an audit commit on the combined branch. Library and ResearchSubject are active in source/fhir.ini, and publish.ini plus the Library examples page show that the model-definition content XML is build-scoped and published.
reconciliation: Changed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml so ResearchSubject.status uses FHIR.PublicationStatus, removed the stale ResearchSubjectStatus ClassInfo and conversionInfo, removed the obsolete FHIRHelpers ToString overload, and synchronized the embedded base64 Library resource data in source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml and source/library/library-fhir-helpers.xml.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: ResearchSubject.status now has elementType FHIR.PublicationStatus; stale ResearchSubjectStatus ClassInfo and conversionInfo were removed.
source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml: embedded model-definition data was synchronized with the updated content XML.
source/library/library-fhir-helpers-content.cql: obsolete ToString(value FHIR.ResearchSubjectStatus) helper was removed.
source/library/library-fhir-helpers.xml: embedded FHIRHelpers data was synchronized with the updated CQL content.
